cases.question: What is revenue?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM retail

cases.question: What are gross sales excluding returns?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales FROM retail

cases.question: Revenue by region, highest first
cases.referenceSql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM retail GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC, region
